steps.text: Click the dossier row to open its page. Documents are always added inside a dossier.
steps.title: Open the dossier

steps.text: The "Documents" tab lists the dossier's pieces. A freshly created dossier holds none.
steps.title: An empty dossier

steps.text: Click "Add document" to choose which regulatory form to prepare.
steps.title: Add a document

steps.text: The list holds the forms published by the regulator for your region. Each one knows which CRM data it has to carry.
steps.title: Choose the form

steps.text: Give the document a title that identifies it in the dossier.
steps.title: Name the document

steps.text: Submit: the document joins the dossier, still without any content.
steps.title: Create the document

steps.text: The document is created with the status "Draft". It has no content yet: the icons offer to generate it from the CRM or to upload your own file.
steps.title: A draft is waiting

steps.text: Click the generate icon. OptimCE gathers the data of the community, the operation and its members to fill the form.
steps.title: Generate the document

steps.text: Nothing is filed without your review. The fields are pre-filled from the CRM and stay editable: what you approve here is exactly what gets frozen into the document.
steps.title: Check the data

steps.text: A correction made here applies to this document only. If a value is wrong everywhere, fix it in the CRM instead and reload the form.
steps.title: Correct a value

steps.text: The generation runs in the background. You can carry on working: the document card shows "Generating" and updates on its own.
steps.title: Start the generation

steps.text: Once the generation finishes, the document carries a downloadable version. Nothing is overwritten: every generation adds a new version.
steps.title: The document is ready

steps.text: The "Versions" icon opens the document's full history.
steps.title: Look at the versions

steps.text: Every version records when it was produced and by whom. Generated versions additionally keep the exact data that was used.
steps.title: A record of what was produced

steps.text: Open the snapshot to re-read the data exactly as it was at filing time. A later change in the CRM never rewrites what was submitted.
steps.title: See the frozen data

steps.text: Close the window when you are done.
steps.title: Close

title: Generate a document from the CRM
